text: Bonding makes a creature yours for good. A familiar sheds **double** reagent when you brush it, once a minute, and no one else can brush it.
Every creature carries five threads: **Frame** (health), **Stride** (speed), **Fang** (damage), **Hum** (how often its gift works) and **Keep** (armour). Each step up or down is worth 12%.
**Sneak and look at any March creature** to see its threads, its Marks, its generation and its **bloodline**, the five threads added up. Your own companions show theirs whenever you look at them.
Wild threads roll 0 to 3, so two foxes from the same clearing are not clones. Only breeding reaches 4, and the **Exalted** 5. Choose the one you want to keep: bonding never rerolls anything.
pages.title: Read it first

text: There are two ways to bond a grown creature. Young ones cannot be bonded.

- **Feed it**, the way you would win over a wolf. Gentle animals take their usual food and bond about one time in three; remnants take their own reagent and bond one time in five. Every try spends the food.

- **Use a Bonding Charm** on it: three tries in five for gentle animals, two in five for remnants. The charm is used up when the bond takes. A failed try keeps it with a gentle animal, but spends it on a remnant.
A remnant answers either way only once its tribe calls you **Voice** ([who can be bonded](familiar_basics)). Hearts mean it worked; smoke means it did not.
pages.title: Bonding

text: Make it early from **four String** around a **Spirit Shard** and **one creature reagent**. Once you have Spiritweave, **two Spiritweave** can stand in for the string.

The reagent can be any of nine: Dawn Velvet, Lantern Down, Mossback Scale, Prism Carapace, Rift Tooth, Cinder Knot, Storm Wing, Bell Fragment or Echo Silk. Brush a Dawn Stag, Lantern Fox or Mossback for one, once a minute, or take one from a fallen remnant; other beasts' reagents will not fit. Whichever went in, the charm bonds any creature that will answer.
The same charm later gives your familiar a voice: see [attuning at a totem](familiar_attuning).
pages.title: The Bonding Charm

pages.text: Any one of the nine creature reagents fills the top middle slot.

text: A familiar follows once you are **10 blocks** away and teleports to you past **12**. It ignores your blows.
Sneak-use it to make it wait, and again to call it back. Hold something while you do it to a Mossback, because an empty hand opens its saddlebag.

**One fighter** (a Shardback or Rift Hound) and **two helpers** may follow at once. Sitters and anything being ridden do not count. Extras sit down and tell you why. A waiting familiar that gets hurt stands up and follows, if there is room in your company.
What your familiar kills earns you no tribe standing and does not count for a tribe's hunts. The kill has to be your own.
pages.title: Keeping company

text: Breed two bonded companions of the same species by feeding both their food while they stand close. Wild animals breed too, if you sneak as you feed them, and their young are born wild. As with wolves, the young of two companions you own are **born into your company**, and more food helps them grow.
Each child takes one half of every thread from each parent, sometimes nudged up or down. Pairs you own together improve a little more often.

**Breed strong to strong.** When both parents are 3 or better in a thread, the child has a one-in-four chance to go a step higher than either, which is the only way to 4 and the Exalted 5. A line bred with care ends up far stronger than anything wild.
Careful with copying: breeding the same Frame and Fang three generations running under one owner **Frays** the line and lowers its Hum.
pages.title: Breeding better threads

text: Marks are named quirks. Some show with one copy; the rest need a copy from both parents.

- One copy: **Quiet Thread** (follows from 8 blocks, stops at 2), **Stonehide** (+1 armour, a little slower), **Drift** (quicker, 2 less health, gets restless after a minute of waiting), **Soft Maw** (will not bite villagers or golems), **Glow-vein** (fox), **Brace** (Shardback).

- Two copies: **Keen** (gift works faster), **Night Hum** (faster at night), **Kin Mark** (born to one owner's pair, a touch more armour), and the species marks **Leap**, **Deep Pocket**, **Track**, **Tempo**, **Click-true**, **Still** and **Gather**.
A few March-born wild creatures are **Sparked**: they glitter, and carry a strong copy of the thread their species leans toward.
pages.title: Marks
Healing a familiar
text: Feed a hurt familiar its favourite food to heal it. A [salve](remedies) used on it, burning incense and the [Healer's Rattle](healers_rattle) heal it too.
If one falls, it leaves a **Spirit Remnant**. A [Healing Circle](healing_circle) calls it back, voice and all.
